subject: Urgent: EU sandbox temporary restore window + log-retention carve-in request
messages:
From: Lena Morales <lena.morales@acmelabs.com>
To: jonas.weber@redwood.com
Cc: audit@acmelabs.com
Date: 2026-12-13 08:12 +01:00
Subject: Request: temporary hold on EU sandbox purge + log carve-in

Hi Jonas —

Quick one from the audit team: we discovered a gap in our sandbox evidence for a forthcoming regulator review and need Redwood's help to preserve recent backups and logs for the EU sandbox workspace (eu-sandbox-01). Specifically we need:

- A temporary pause on the scheduled backup purge (the run scheduled for 2026-12-15 at 02:00 CET) for eu-sandbox-01.
- A 90-day preservation for system logs flagged "kv-access" and "audit-trace" (we only need logs from 2026-09-01 onward).
- A short-term extension of the restore window from 30 -> 90 days for snapshots tagged "acme-eu-sandbox".

We understand this is out of the ordinary; auditors want a documented hold and an export manifest listing preserved objects. Also: please confirm whether this change will involve cross-border transfers (some of our auditors will want to see subprocessor confirmations and DPA language).

Attaching the audit request form. We need confirmation within 24 hours if possible.

Thanks,
Lena
Lena Morales
Acme Labs — Compliance Lead
Attachment: audit_request_20261213.pdf

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-12-13 09:05 +01:00
Subject: Re: Request: temporary hold on EU sandbox purge + log carve-in

Thanks Lena — looping in ops and legal. Internal team: see request from Acme (attached). They need a hold on the scheduled purge (2026-12-15) and a 90-day carve-in for two log streams and snapshot retention.

Operational asks (Dev / Hannah / Marcus):
- Can we implement a technical hold that prevents the purge from running for eu-sandbox-01? If yes, please snapshot/tag with "hold-acme-20261213" and produce an object manifest.
- Please capture the current snapshot manifest and provide estimated storage delta for +60 days and +90 days.

Legal (Kimberly / Laura):
- Need confirmation on whether preserving these artifacts will cause any cross-border transfers. If it does, we need to trigger the DPA amendment path and provide Acme with the subprocessor list and any SCC/transfer mechanism details.

Acme: we'll aim to respond with a containment plan inside 24h and a proposed timeline for evidence delivery.

Jonas
Director, Customer Reliability
Redwood Inference

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-12-13 11:18 +01:00
Subject: Re: Request: temporary hold on EU sandbox purge + log carve-in

We can do the technical hold. Plan below:

1) Prevent purge run: flip archival_policy.pause=true for workspace eu-sandbox-01 — this prevents scheduled purge jobs from enqueuing.
2) Create a snapshot manifest named hold-acme-20261213 and copy metadata to a preserved-bucket (read-only) for 90 days. We'll export a CSV manifest listing object keys and sizes (will drop into attachments).
3) For logs, we can mark two log groups (kv-access, audit-trace) with retention_override=90d and export the last 90 days to the preserve bucket.

Estimated storage delta: ~28GB for 90 days (snapshots + exported logs).

We'll carry out step 1 within 2 hours of legal OK; steps 2–3 will take ~6 hours to complete and we'll send the manifest.

Attaching manifest once created.

—Hannah
Senior SRE, Redwood Inference

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Lena Morales <lena.morales@acmelabs.com>, jonas.weber@redwood.com
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, hannah.schmitt@redwood.com
Date: 2026-12-13 14:42 +01:00
Subject: Re: Request: temporary hold on EU sandbox purge + log carve-in

Hi Lena / Acme audit team —

Legal here. We can support a temporary preservation hold while we process a DPA amendment to explicitly cover the preservation requested. A few notes:

- Preservation window: Redwood will place an operational hold for 90 days starting when Hannah confirms the hold is in place.
- Cross-border transfers: based on the current config, object metadata indicates your snapshots and exports will remain in the EU region (Frankfurt). If any export to a non-EU region is required we'll request documented justification.
- Subprocessors: attached is an excerpted subprocessor list; we will provide the full list and updated DPA addendum via DocuSign.
- Evidence artifacts: we'll provide the snapshot manifest and a signed attestation from Redwood that the hold was applied at X time and released at Y time.

Please review the draft DPA amendment at the DocuSign link below and countersign so we can keep the hold in place while we finalize paperwork. Once signed, Ops will proceed and we'll record logs of all actions for your audit.

DocuSign: https://app.docusign.com/Acme-Redwood-DPA-amendment-2026
Attachment: dpa_amendment_draft.docx

Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Privacy & Compliance
Redwood Inference

From: Lena Morales <lena.morales@acmelabs.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, jonas.weber@redwood.com
Date: 2026-12-14 16:05 +01:00
Subject: Re: Request: temporary hold on EU sandbox purge + log carve-in

Laura / team —

Thanks, that's exactly what we needed. I have routed the DPA amendment to our legal signatory (should be back to you shortly). Please proceed with the operational hold and send the manifest when ready.

We'll confirm when auditors are satisfied. Appreciate the quick turnaround.

Best,
Lena
Acme Labs — Compliance Lead
